summary.goal: Enable recovery from Forgemaster crashes, agent failures, and infrastructure issues without re-executing completed work. Provide health monitoring and checkpointing.

acceptance_criteria.description: Checkpoint created after each task completion (snapshot of run state)
On Forgemaster restart, recover active runs from last checkpoint
Detect orphaned agents (spawned but Forgemaster crashed) and clean up
Resume paused runs from exact state (pending gates, queued tasks)
Health monitoring: detect stuck agents (no messages for N minutes)
Graceful shutdown: wait for in-progress tasks or timeout
Recovery log showing what was recovered and any issues

observations: Temporal-inspired durability but simpler (not full event replay)
Checkpoints are snapshots, not full event log replay
Orphan detection via relay agent listing vs. DB expected agents
Health monitoring prevents silent agent hangs
patterns: Checkpoint after each task state transition
Recovery: load checkpoint -> verify agents -> resume queuing
Heartbeat from agents or periodic presence check
concerns: Agent orphan cleanup must not kill still-working agents

architect.checkpoint_trigger: After each task completion or gate resolution

steps.title: Define checkpoint schema
steps.description: Define checkpoint data structure for run state snapshots

acceptance_criteria.description: CheckpointSchema: { checkpoint_id, run_id, run_status, has_pending_gate, tasks_snapshot: JSONB, active_agents: string[], created_at }
tasks_snapshot includes: all task statuses, current attempts, pending gates
active_agents lists agent IDs that should be running (agent name pattern)

architecture.pattern: Snapshot of run state at point in time

steps.title: Verify checkpoints table in storage
steps.description: Checkpoints table schema defined in forge-storage, verify storage methods work

acceptance_criteria.description: Verify ForgeStorage.createCheckpoint() works with checkpoint schema
Verify ForgeStorage.getLatestCheckpoint(runId) retrieves most recent
Verify ForgeStorage.listCheckpoints(runId) returns all checkpoints

specification.notes: Table schema defined in forge-storage fs-s7

steps.title: Implement checkpoint creation
steps.description: Create checkpoint after task state transitions

acceptance_criteria.description: createCheckpoint(runId) captures current run state
Called after: task completion, task failure, gate resolution
Captures: all task statuses, active agents via spawner.listActiveAgents()
Async, non-blocking (should not slow down main flow)

architecture.trigger: Hook on state transitions, not synchronous in critical path

steps.title: Implement run recovery on startup
steps.description: Recover active runs from checkpoints on Forgemaster restart

acceptance_criteria.description: recoverActiveRuns() called on Forgemaster startup
Find runs with status 'running' or 'paused' in DB
For each: load latest checkpoint, verify agent states, resume scheduling
Log recovery actions for debugging

architecture.startup_hook: Called in server initialization, before accepting new runs

steps.title: Implement orphan agent detection
steps.description: Detect and clean up agents that were running when Forgemaster crashed

acceptance_criteria.description: detectOrphanAgents() compares expected vs. actual running agents
Expected: from checkpoint active_agents list
Actual: call spawner.listActiveAgents() which uses relay SDK agent listing
Orphans (running but not expected): terminate gracefully
Missing (expected but not running): mark task for retry

architecture.relay_api: AgentSpawner.listActiveAgents() uses relay SDK to list running agents
architecture.grace_period: Wait 30s before terminating (agent might still be starting)

steps.title: Implement health monitoring for stuck agents
steps.description: Detect agents that haven't sent messages for too long

acceptance_criteria.description: trackAgentHeartbeat(agentId, timestamp) updates last seen time
Heartbeat updated on: report_progress tool calls, relay messages
detectStuckAgents() finds agents with no activity for N minutes
Stuck agent: terminate and mark task for retry
Configurable threshold: FORGE_AGENT_STUCK_THRESHOLD (default 5 min)

architecture.heartbeat_source: MCP tool calls via report_progress, relay messages

steps.title: Implement graceful shutdown
steps.description: Clean shutdown waiting for in-progress tasks

acceptance_criteria.description: On SIGTERM: stop accepting new runs, stop enqueueing tasks
Wait for in-progress tasks to complete (up to timeout)
After timeout: create checkpoint, terminate agents
Configurable timeout: FORGE_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT (default 60s)

steps.title: Create recovery log endpoint
steps.description: API endpoint to view recovery actions

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /health/recovery returns last recovery log
Log includes: runs recovered, orphans terminated, tasks retried
Timestamp of last recovery

architecture.storage: In-memory or simple file for recovery log
